findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "web" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: web_search, web_fetch, web_contents, web_extract, web_check, agent_access_check · Private data: document_to_markdown, extract_tables · Public sink: web_search, web_contents, web_extract, extract_tables.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: web_search, web_fetch, web_contents, web_extract, web_check, agent_access_check · Private data: document_to_markdown, extract_tables · Public sink: web_search, web_contents, web_extract, extract_tables

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
